verification_summary.balance_notes: Race cornelius-council (one certified candidate). Baker has 4 bio and 5 positions, all T1. No balance comparison is possible. Vote-for number: the county certified-candidate PDF is image-only and the pamphlet prints no 'vote for'. The city's Aug 2022 Gazette says councilors' 4-year terms run through Dec 31, 2026 for two seats (then Colgan and Hernandez). This is consistent with seats=2, but no 2026 official text confirms it. File-level: name matches pamphlet/official listing. Incumbent false confirmed: Cornelius council page lists Colgan, Lopez, Gonzalez, Godinez; Baker's pamphlet lists council service as prior experience.
